answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence is proportional to capital locked in the network. This system ensures that an attacker must acquire a marble of the total supply to gain consensus control, a feat that acts as a financial barrier against malicious expansion. Since the cost scales linearly, agents cannot harbor unlimited identities without exhausting their capital, creating a dawn of economic security where identity fabrication becomes prohibitively expensive.
